decisions.decision: Inline gravity-comp into trajectory_shim's _publish path; remove gravity_comp_node from production launch
decisions.rationale: IPC split caused partial-target bug, phase jitter, integrator stall. Same-thread compute eliminates all three. gravity_comp_node still ships for --calibrate mode.

decisions.decision: Cubic Hermite interp at 50 Hz with zero-velocity endpoints in trajectory_shim
decisions.rationale: Linear interp at 20 Hz gave step-discontinuous setpoints the Feetech PD treated as impulses. Hermite + zero endpoints give C1-continuous rest-to-rest motion. Measured shoulder_lift hold 2.62° → 0.04°, settle NaN → 10ms.

decisions.decision: Integrator tuned to alpha=0.2, i_max=4°, deadband=0.3°, dwell=0.5s, rate=2 Hz
decisions.rationale: Aggressive (alpha=0.4 i_max=8°) hunted on fast motions where servo couldn't reach target. Gentler tuning converges on smooth motions, doesn't wind up against unreachable targets on fast motions.

decisions.decision: feetech_calib_audit.py uses 12-bit sign-magnitude decode for Homing_Offset (bit 11 = sign)
decisions.rationale: Was reading as int16; lerobot's motors_bus.py decodes sign-magnitude internally before storing JSON. Mismatch was decoder artifact, not real calibration drift. Wasted hours chasing phantom mismatches.

decisions.decision: recenter_one_to_commanded service removed (built then removed in same session)
decisions.rationale: GPT confirmed via Feetech protocol manual: in-place EEPROM Homing rewrite without physical motion is architecturally impossible for cable-loaded joints. Goal_Position is interpreted in post-Homing coords. Existing freedrive_one + recenter_one + lerobot-calibrate cover the calibration space.

decisions.decision: Gripper sync requires all 6 joints in initial /joint_states message
decisions.rationale: Old code marked _initial_sync_done on first message; jsr's first publish during bring-up sometimes omitted gripper, leaving slider stuck at 0. Now waits for full message.

decisions.decision: Real-mode lego collision push only on explicit Refresh, not auto on every /objects_poses tick
decisions.rationale: yoloe jitter from wrist-cam angle changes the projected centroid, firing the >3mm threshold ~1-2 Hz, causing planning-scene flicker. Cache still updates so listbox is live.
